text: At its meeting on May 18, 2022, the TO Live - Planning and Priorities Committee considered item RX10.2 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of TO Live. Summary from the report (May 10, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live: The purpose of this report is to provide an outline of TO Live's key performance indicators (KPIs) from its 2022 Goals and Objectives that were submitted in June 2021 with the 2022 Plan and Budget.
The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Received the report (May 10, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live for information.
